description: Startup and small business economics in one call; give any complete group. Unit economics (arpu, grossMargin, monthlyChurn, cac): LTV, LTV/CAC grade, CAC payback months. Runway (cash, revenue, expenses, monthly growth rates): month-by-month cash, the month cash runs out, break-even month and whether the company is default alive. Break-even (fixedCost, price, variableCost): units and revenue. Same engine as tools.oiyo.net.

discountRate.description: Annual discount rate for LTV, default 0

expenses.description: Monthly expenses now, including cost of sales

fixedCost.description: Fixed cost for the break-even period

name: calculate_unit_economics_runway
title: Calculate unit economics runway
